questions.question: Draw a supply curve and show an extension of supply following a rise in price. (4 marks)
Explain how the imposition of a specific tax of $3 per unit affects the supply curve for a good. (4 marks)
Analyse two factors that could cause the supply curve for cement to shift to the left. (6 marks)
The price of a good rises from $8 to $10. Quantity supplied rises from 400 to 460 units a week. Calculate the price elasticity of supply and interpret the value. (4 marks)
Examine the factors that influence the price elasticity of supply of fresh cut flowers. (8 marks)
Discuss the significance of the distinction between the short run and the long run for the price elasticity of supply of a mineral such as lithium. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that price elasticity of supply is the most important factor determining how far the price of rice rises when demand increases in a developing economy. (20 marks)
